Speaker: Ghost

Speaker: Girl

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Girl

Speaker: Ghost

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Ghost

column6: I would have had to leave you.

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Girl

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Ghost
Dialogue: What's left of me is enough for one last thing.

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Ghost
Dialogue: I'll put all of it into this ring. Wear it

Speaker: Girl

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Girl

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Ghost
Dialogue: That won't get you home

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Ghost

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Girl
Dialogue: Then I'm not going home!

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Girl
Dialogue: I don't want some stupid ring. I want you to come home with me!

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Girl
Dialogue: Why are you all like this...? You make all these promises
column6: and then

Name: Collectible3
Speaker: Girl

Speaker: Ghost
Dialogue: ...I know.

Name: Collectible3
